Circuit courts are the primary trial courts in the United States, handling a wide range of cases at the state level. They have general jurisdiction, which means they can hear and decide cases involving nearly any subject matter. The Lane County Circuit Court is one such court located in Eugene, Oregon, serving the residents of Lane County.

The Jurisdiction of Lane County Circuit Court

The Lane County Circuit Court has jurisdiction over a variety of cases, including:

Criminal Cases

These cases involve the prosecution of individuals charged with committing crimes. The court has the authority to hear both misdemeanors and felonies, which can range from minor offenses like traffic violations to serious crimes such as murder.
